items.summary: Command injection in DrayTek Vigor2960 1.5.1.6 (set_table in /cgi-bin/mainfunction.cgi) via a manipulated sectiontype argument; remotely exploitable with a public exploit. The device is end-of-support — replace it, as only major unauthenticated issues get reviewed.

Buffer overflow in Tenda BE3L Pro 16.03.60.62 (formWifiBasicSet in /goform/WifiBasicSet) via a manipulated security_5g argument; remotely exploitable with a published exploit. Patch or retire affected units.

PHP object injection in the WordPress Prime Mover backup/migration plugin up to 2.2.1 via deserialization in the migration search-and-replace routine; an unauthenticated attacker can plant a crafted serialized object through a comment. Update past 2.2.1 immediately.
Request smuggling in Apache Traffic Server via HEAD requests carrying Content-Length or Transfer-Encoding, affecting 8.0.0–8.1.11, 9.0.0–9.2.15 and 10.x lines. Upgrade to 9.2.16, 10.1.5 or 10.2.1.

Missing authorization in OpenRemote before 1.31.0 (GatewayServiceResource) lets any authenticated user start, stop and query gateway tunnels, opening persistent TCP circuits into an edge gateway's network. Upgrade to 1.31.0.
